summary: A planned backward-compatible revision of the glTF core, announced on 2026-06-11 and still being written. Its purpose is to let one file deliver a whole assembled scene instead of a single model: a file may reference other glTF files and instantiate them, package them inside itself, carry simple shapes such as boxes and spheres, and hang bounding volumes on nodes. Seven of the announced features have draft specification text - those four, plus thumbnails, the 64-bit binary container and the deprecation of multiple scenes, merged on 2026-08-28 - and only on the working group's draft-2.1 branch; the published Khronos registry still has no 2.1 document, and no primary source states a ratification target date. Everything else on the announced list - unique identifiers, promoted extensions and wider number types - is announced only, and is scored partial here for that reason. The shape work is the one to watch: the same box, sphere, capsule, cylinder and plane vocabulary that the physics and collision extensions were going to supply now sits in the core, and the working group has stated that the pending KHR_implicit_shapes extension is superseded by it - though that extension's pull request is still open and the extension registry has not been changed to say so. This is also the format that the international scene description standard extends: MPEG-I Scene Description, ISO/IEC 23090-14:2025, defines no scene format of its own and states in its own abstract that its extensions are provided for ISO/IEC 12113, which is glTF 2.0 - so the two overlap across the whole asset side, with glTF owning the container, geometry, materials and animation and the MPEG part owning timed media on top, and with interactivity now being defined twice, once by each body. Those MPEG extensions are pinned to glTF 2.0, so a core revision is something that standard has to catch up with rather than something it inherits.

coverage.note: The draft is a complete core asset delivery specification carrying scenes and models between tools, with assets declaring version 2.1; it exists only as draft text on the draft-2.1 branch and is not yet published to the Khronos registry.
